title: Source Status (v1.0.0)
description: Data-quality status of the telemetry sources for the active corridor. Produced by the data layer (gold view). Screen US-03. See ADR-0003.

schema_version.description: Read contract version (SemVer). Turn 1 produces only 1.0.0.

snapshot_id.description: UUID v4 identifying this gold snapshot. Referenced by recommendation.lineage.snapshot_id.

as_of_ts.description: UTC timestamp when the gold view was computed.

status.description: Overall corridor status. 'live' = all active buses reporting within 2 min. 'estimated' = at least one bus not reporting > 2 min (no alert raised). 'no_data' = no events ever received.

sources_down.description: List of buses that have not reported for more than 2 minutes. Empty when status is 'live'.

since.description: UTC timestamp of the last received event from this bus.
